description: How repo/scripts/toolkit-risk-tier.cjs tags a change in this repository. A changed path takes the first list it matches: risky, then normal, then light; anything else is NORMAL. Inside a list, a pattern starting with ! takes one file (its full path, no wildcards) back out and the last match wins. Patterns ignore letter case, except ! entries, which match their file exactly; reading from git, a path also keeps the tier the list at the merge base gave it. RISKY is everything setup, the bridge, a hook or an installer runs or copies out, everything a workflow with a write token or secret runs, the data files RISKY code names by path, and instructions, governance and host config. So code folders are RISKY as a whole, and each ! entry names one script in a script folder, a developer tool or read-only CI step that the closure test proves no RISKY file reaches; a workflow, instruction or data file can never be an exception. A file whose changed lines only bump the product version (a JSON "version" key, a managed-block marker's toolkit= value, or a version constant outside the risky paths) is LIGHT. Editing this list is itself RISKY.
